verses.english: “Sir, they speak of someone who is ‘poor’.
How is a poor person defined?”

verses.pali: “Sattannaṁ kho, bhikkhu, bojjhaṅgānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘daliddo’ti vuccati.
verses.english: “Mendicant, they’re called poor because they haven’t developed and cultivated the seven awakening factors.
The awakening factors of mindfulness, investigation of principles, energy, rapture, tranquility, immersion, and equanimity.

verses.pali: imesaṁ kho, bhikkhu, sattannaṁ bojjhaṅgānaṁ abhāvitattā abahulīkatattā ‘daliddo’ti vuccatī”ti.
verses.english: They’re called poor because they haven’t developed and cultivated these seven awakening factors.”
